description: When personal data is collected directly from data subjects, required information is not provided at the time of collection. Article 13 specifies mandatory information elements.
applicability: Applicable to all direct data collection from data subjects. Includes online forms, registration processes, and any point where personal data is collected from individuals.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data collection points and associated privacy notices. Verify all Article 13 required elements are provided at collection time.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject
